title: Record-breaking builds
text: Some players do not use Minecraft only to survive. For them, it is a giant digital construction kit. Over the years, amazing projects have been built by players from all over the world.

One of the most famous is a copy of the world of Westeros, from a famous fantasy series. It was built by a group of hundreds of players called WesterosCraft. Every castle, city and road was planned carefully, and the project took many years.

In Denmark, the government decided to do something unusual. In 2014 the whole country was recreated in Minecraft at a real scale, using official maps. Every building, road and field was placed in the right position.

Other builders prefer to use redstone, a material that works like electricity in the game. With redstone, working computers and even simple video games have been created inside Minecraft. These machines are made of millions of blocks.
Projects like these show that a game can also be a place to learn. Players learn architecture, planning and teamwork. And sometimes, a simple block is the beginning of something enormous.

grammar.title: Grammar: the passive voice
grammar.rule: Use the passive when the action is more important than who does it: was / were + past participle (+ by).
rows: They built it. → It was built.
Players made them. → They were made by players.
items: The castle ___ built by hundreds of players.
These machines are ___ of millions of blocks.
